cim: From RCM Automation to Agentic AI: What Changes When AI Can Actually Work the Revenue Cycle?
cim_eredeti: From RCM Automation to Agentic AI: What Changes When AI Can Actually Work the Revenue Cycle?
szoveg_eredeti:
Dr. Pamela Maragliano, chief editor of Dental Economics, sits down with Dalton Knoderer, vice president of sales at Zentist, to talk about how AI agents can improve dental revenue cycle management and performance. Knoderer explains how AI can help dental practices and DSOs investigate denied claims, identify coding errors, automate payment posting, and verify insurance benefits. Unlike traditional bots, AI agents can adapt to changes in insurance portals. He emphasizes balancing automation with human oversight and measuring ROI through reduced processing costs, faster reimbursements, and improved cash flow.

Watch the video now to listen to the full conversation!
